description: Broadcast Campaigns module for sending mass WhatsApp templates to segmented contact lists.

layout_structure.main_area: Centered content container (max-width: 800px) for step-by-step campaign creation.

card.content: Template Name, Preview text (gray bubble), Category badge (Marketing/Utility)

variables_mapping.title: Map Variables
variables_mapping.description: Map your CRM fields to the template variables.

preview_pane.description: A live mobile phone mockup showing how the message will look on WhatsApp.
preview_pane.location: Floating on the right side of the screen on desktop.
preview_pane.style: Rounded rectangle, light green WhatsApp background, message bubble with mapped variables.

footer_actions.layout: Flex horizontal, justify end, gap 16px, sticky bottom, padding 16px, background surface.primary, border-top.

visual_prompt_notes: A SaaS interface showing a step-by-step 'Create Broadcast' wizard. The main area contains a white card with a clean form for selecting a WhatsApp template and mapping variables. On the right side, there is a realistic mobile phone mockup displaying a live preview of a WhatsApp message. Top of the screen shows a step progress bar (Setup -> Template -> Audience -> Review). Uses yellow (#FFE27C) for the active 'Next' button and progress indicators.
